subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The brave and courageous soldiers / of our motherland / fell into the enemy / and won the battle.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "fell into the enemy" is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be "fell upon the enemy," which means to attack the enemy.
 
• The error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The brave and courageous soldiers of our motherland fell upon the enemy and won the battle."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "and won the battle,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "The brave and courageous soldiers,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "of our motherland,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
